data: In all subplots, is the value of the red square higher than 0.6 when the threshold is 0.6?

The question asks whether the value of the red square is higher than 0.6 when the threshold is set at 0.6. From the caption, we know that the red square represents recall. In the first subplot, the red square (recall) is below 0.6 when the threshold is 0.6. Therefore, the value of the red square is not higher than 0.6 when the threshold is 0.6.
